title: Chase and Yonas cognitive enhancement patent

tellings.quote: Enter Lockheed Martin engineers Charles Chase and Gerald Yonas with a patent called cognitive [music] enhancement using feedback.

plain: Around 2020, two engineers at Lockheed Martin, an American weapons and aircraft company, named Charles Chase and Gerald Yonas, filed a patent called "cognitive enhancement using feedback", meaning a way to boost thinking. Michels tells this himself while discussing a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor. He raises it as a sign that a big defense company was working on ways to improve the human mind.
